attributes.board_name: Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation (Board of Nursing)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Approved sponsors under Rule 1300.130(c) (e.g. ANCC-accredited providers, AANP, ISAPN, NPACE, AANA/NBCRNA, ACNM, CME conferences) or licensed Illinois nursing CE sponsors; min. 50 h in CE programs, max. 30 h from presentations, publications, research or precepting; recertification exam = 60 h
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE for the first renewal of an Illinois APRN or FPA-APRN license.
rules.carryover: Hours used for another jurisdiction may be applied.
rules.alternatives: The 80 APRN hours also satisfy the RN license CE.
rules.audit_note: Keep certificates; produce them if the Department requests.

topics.who: Holders of an Illinois Controlled Substances Registration (safe opioid prescribing, to renew the registration)
APRNs with direct patient interaction with adults 26 and older

rules.legal_basis: 68 Ill. Adm. Code 1300.130 (Rules for the Administration of the Nurse Practice Act)
rules.notes: 80 h per 2-year cycle, in the 24 months before expiry; at least 20 h pharmacotherapeutics incl. 10 h opioid prescribing or substance abuse education. Implicit bias, sexual harassment and dementia hours count within the 80. The 2024 renewal was due June 30, 2024.
